content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Haldwani Forest Division Working Plan Associate Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.forest.uk.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 05-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Haldwani Forest Division Working Plan Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Working Plan Associate post is 05 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Working Plan Associate position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in Botany, Zoology, Forestry, Wildlife, or Soil Sciences from a recognized university with a First Division (at least 60% Marks).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Working Plan Associate post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Working Plan Associate post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/Women candidates as per Uttarakhand state government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Working Plan Associate role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 25,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Haldwani Forest Division Working Plan Associate job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Working Plan Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Working Plan Associate post in the Haldwani Forest Division.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Working Plan Associate position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the scrutiny of applications followed by an interview, which can be conducted in person or online.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the Working Plan Associate position is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Forest Department, Uttarakhand: www.forest.uk.gov.in.
